title.narrative: Output 8.1. Increased capacity of Member States to develop new or reformed sustainable national social protection strategies, policies or legal frameworks to extend coverage and enhance benefit adequacy

description.narrative: 1)China started the implementation of private pensions in April 2022, marking a milestone in establishing a multi-tier pension system. The new mechanism characterized by policy support (tax incentives), voluntary participation, and market-oriented operations, is being piloted in 36 cities for one year (since November 2022). By June 2023, 40.3 million people had opened a private pension account in 36 pilot cities (regions). 2)The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (MOHRSS) adopted a new policy on occupational injury insurance for workers in new forms of work and started piloting it in seven provinces and seven platform companies since July 2022. The new policy requires platform companies (in food delivery, transport, instant delivery, and intra-city freight sectors) to enroll their workers in the new occupational injury insurance scheme and pay contributions (only employer contributions). According to MOHRSS, by July 2023, 6.15 million workers were covered. 1)The ILO, with the support of the European Union, developed a technical note that included a review of the multi-tier pension system in China and assessed the performance of China's pension system against relevant international labour standards, and gave recommendations in particular on the coherence of the pension system. The ILO organized several technical discussions inviting international and Chinese experts to discuss reform options, which have provided the Chinese government with theoretic and practical support in their pension reform process. 2)The ILO carried out research on assessing social security coverage of workers in diverse forms of employment in China focusing on platform workers during 2022. Several seminars were organized with the MOHRSS to share experiences in this area of common interest for other countries. The studies, seminars, and various discussions provided ample evidence that contributed to the policy formulation.

description.narrative: MOHRSS adopted the National Action Plan on Digital Human Resources and Social Security Services in June 2023. It aims to build an integrated, digitalized, and intelligent system that supports the modernization of the governance system and governance capacity in human resources and social security services. The ILO supported MOHRSS in developing a digital transformation strategy and a data governance action plan for social security administration and services in China in 2022. The ILO facilitated learning from global digital transformation experiences in social security systems in support of China's transformation in line with international best practices. These efforts greatly contributed to the development of the recent national action plan on digital human resources and social security, which was released in June 2023.
